summary.text: Mike Reichenbach is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 31 in Florence County.
His official page lists him as president and owner of Mike Reichenbach Ford, Lincoln, Chevy & VW, and a member of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Reichenbach was born on October 29, 1971, in Lima, Ohio.
His official page lists a 1994 degree from Bowling Green State University and an MBA from the University of Michigan in 2000.
He was named Greater Florence Chamber of Commerce Businessperson of the Year in 2011 and was promoted to major in the S.C. Military Department's Volunteer Joint Services Detachment in 2018.
His committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Transportation.
